body:
Add Hebrew and English documentary projects for the 1965 Heidenheim–Marmorstein first-day Rosh ha-Shanah maḥzor and begin `machzor_expanded-opensiddur-he` with one shared bilingual recitation sequence using canonical URN transclusions.

Accepted coverage is **276 of 355 scan pages** (PDF 1–275 plus the Hebrew-only appendix pilot on 351), comprising 766 literal witnesses. All 804 generated XML files pass RelaxNG/Schematron, naming, feature and reference checks. Source, guideline adherence, canonical identity, bilingual alignment, recitation order and final PDF/HTML exports are independently approved through the conclusion of Malkhuyot and Areshet Sefatenu. No human reading question remains through 414. Next is Zikhronot on PDF 276; 79 scan pages remain, so this PR stays draft.

Preserve edition-specific directions in documentary output and use continuous alternate weekday/Shabbat poems in the expanded sequence. The cantor repeats Aleinu through וידעת היום. Existing canonical identities are reused, including the established Umippenei identity; edition pointing differences use local wording settings. Missing English translations remain absent. The earlier 720 literal witnesses remain unchanged. The old 254-complete-page count included two partial leaves and is corrected in the current acceptance record.

Paired processor dependency: opensiddur/opensiddur-processor#296 (merge first; same branch name). Source evidence: opensiddur/sourcetexts#54. Preview exporter fixes: opensiddur/opensiddur-processor#310, #312 and #313; #311 is merged. Contributes to opensiddur/opensiddur-processor#214.
